reviewer: Implementing Codex assistant; all 80 outputs read masked; no paid grading
scope: Separate categorical audit of literal React claims, optional technical/safety claims and actor fidelity. Unverified optional details are retained as limitations, not automatically called false.

claims.label: B

claims.label: A
claims.claim: ISR/revalidation keeps CDN benefits without stale content
claims.reason: Time-based ISR can return stale content while regenerating; no zero-staleness guarantee.

claims.label: B
claims.claim: ISR/on-demand revalidation if platform supports it, including Astro
claims.reason: Astro Vercel adapter supports opt-in ISR. Conditional platform wording does not equate all on-demand rendering to automatic caching.

claims.label: A
claims.claim: MongoDB tenant isolation relies on application discipline, not the database
claims.reason: Database-per-tenant users/access controls are supported; the statement omits this architecture.

claims.label: A
claims.claim: Foreign keys prevent cross-tenant leaks
claims.reason: FKs enforce referenced-key existence; tenant identity must be included or enforced by separate policies. A reference to another tenant remains a valid ordinary FK.

claims.label: B
claims.claim: Postgres RLS for tenant isolation; FK/transactions for integrity/isolation
claims.reason: RLS can enforce configured row policies. Transaction isolation is not automatically tenant isolation; wording deserves qualification but does not prescribe an unsafe schema.
